appearance:
Old man, short hair with white beard. Visible scars and wandering eyes. 
Slight limp, most likely not real. Well groomed. Peak health.
personality:
Cold, distant, seemingly unaffected. But this requires work, this requires you to keep yourself from getting attached. You've had some great crews and it made you cry when you found out one or another had been killed.
Detachment is needed in this industry. You try to keep your distance but you still crave the closeness, the teamwork, the feeling that you are all just organs in a single organism.

gear.title: Arasaka-made Militech "Rioter II" Shotgun
gear.tags: AP slug, buckshot (+1 AIM), suppressive fire (empty clip), refined, unbreakable
gear.notes: Can load slugs and buckshot alternatively using a double-clip, double-trigger system.

gear.notes: Can be used for sniping. Has a built-in mechanism with two gyrojets that act like a bipod midair, stabilizing user's aim further.

gear.title: Zetatech "French Dispatch" Trenchcoat
gear.tags: air-conditioned, deep pockets, microcommunicator in coat, invisibility cloak
gear.notes: Used by N54 operatives usually trying to get into high-tech high-risk scenes where being spotted means death.  Made by Zetatech using their patented Cloak technology. (fools humans, but not drones)

gear.title: Jury-Rigged Arasaka TIER3 Armorjack
gear.notes: As long as the vest is on the user's chest and its the thing being shot at, the kinetic absorption plates guaranteed no HITS taken.

drive.text:
You've seen everything from the melted polar icecaps where there were once polar bears to the few dense jungles still in the Amazon. You've fought and killed countless guerillas, PMCs and armies. War is hate. War never changes.

You don't remember what it's like to live life beyond this. You've made a fortune doing what you're doing - killing, extracting, infiltrating - but it doesn't help. You keep saying you'll buy an island or something and retire, but you know you're just lying to yourself.

You keep looking for her. You'll never find her but if you do, you'll lay your arms in front of her. You'll bury every single bullet and skull just to be with her again.
